name: Jerome
contribution: An early Christian priest, confessor, theologian, translator, and historian; he is commonly known as Saint Jerome.
legacy: He is best known for his translation of the Bible into Latin, which was commissioned by Pope Damasus I, and his commentaries on the whole Bible.

checks.lead: Jerome of Stridon (; Latin: Eusebius Sophronius Hieronymus; Ancient Greek: Εὐσέβιος Σωφρόνιος Ἱερώνυμος; c. 342–347 – 30 September 420), also known as Hieronymus, was an early Christian priest, confessor, theologian, translator, and historian; he is commonly known as Saint Jerome.
